text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Haa... Somehow, even more than usual...
choice_data_list: Creek, you don't look so good...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I'm sorry for making you worry. I'm 
fine, really. It's nothing serious.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's just that she seems to be getting 
tired more easily than usual...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's not your fault at all, Trainer! 
I'm sure it's just that I got a little too 
carried away~.

Super Creek is smiling, but something is 
clearly off. It might be best to 
reconsider her future race schedule.
